meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes, GSAP timelines, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 HyperFrames 合成添加安全的关键帧动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 HyperFrames 中制作精确的 2D/3D 关键帧动画
copy.tagline_en: Add seek-safe keyframe animations to HyperFrames compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need precise 2D/3D keyframe animations in HyperFrames

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按规范处理 HyperFrames 关键帧任务：识别主体与状态、选择最小动画机制，构建时间线并用命令行验证结果。
howto.when: 当你在 HyperFrames 合成中需要关键帧动画（如 GSAP 时间线、CSS 关键帧、SVG 变形等）或运行 hyperframes keyframes 诊断时触发；不用于场景整体规划、品牌设计等。

say.text: 帮我把这个主体从 A 点移到 B 点，做成一段 GSAP 关键帧动画。
say.note: Claude 会按流程给出规范代码并说明验证步骤。

say.text: 我的 SVG 描边动画想从中间向外展开，该怎么做？

howto.what_en: After install, Claude helps you create and verify seek-safe keyframes for HyperFrames: it identifies the subject, chooses the minimal mechanism, builds the timeline, and uses CLI tools to prove correctness.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a HyperFrames composition needs keyframe animation (e.g., GSAP timelines, CSS keyframes, SVG morphing, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics); not for broad scene planning or brand design.

say_en.text: Create a GSAP keyframe animation moving this subject from point A to point B.
say_en.note: Claude will provide spec-compliant code and verification steps.

say_en.text: Run `hyperframes keyframes --json` to check what's wrong with my animation.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the output and point out errors.

say_en.text: How do I make my SVG stroke draw from the center outward?
say_en.note: Claude will suggest DrawSVG or dasharray approaches.
